Fonts/framdit.ttf.note: Pillow getname() = ('Franklin Gothic Medium','Italic'); this is the XP Start-button face

bold: No Tahoma Bold (tahomabd.ttf) supplied; only Regular 400. font-weight:700 triggers faux-bold smear in browsers; either accept it, or avoid bold (XP caption bars used Trebuchet MS Bold, not supplied -> fall back to 'Trebuchet MS', Tahoma). Franklin Gothic is italic-only, use font-style:italic and never request bold.
licence: Proprietary Microsoft fonts (fsType 8 = editable embedding permitted technically, but EULA forbids redistribution). Fine for local/hackathon demo; do not publish in a public repo/CDN without checking docs/plans/xp-assets-and-licensing.md. Fallback stack: Tahoma, Verdana, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif.
xpMetrics: XP UI text = Tahoma 11px (8pt) regular, no antialiasing smoothing (use -webkit-font-smoothing:auto; image-rendering:pixelated for sprites).
